data.title: [Contingency Contract: Re-Ignition Experimental Operation] Release Details
data.brief: ▼// AvailabilityJune 19, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance※ Asia S
data.data:
▼// Availability

June 19, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Event Update Time

June 26, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)


▼// [Secret Sanctuary] Availability

June 19, 2026 at 12:00 – July 23, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)


▼// Event Rewards

Complete mission goals during the event to earn rewards such as [Portrait: Ancient Contract], [Portrait Frame: Contingent Inscription], and [Vitrified Coins].

Spend [Vitrified Coins] at the [Secret Sanctuary] to exchange for great rewards including [Sticker: Contingency Contract], [Oroberyls], and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate I].


▼// Participation Criteria

· Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process II: Paving the Way]

· Authority Level ≥30


▼// Event Details

· [Contingency Contract] is a high-difficulty free challenge mode, where you can freely combine Test Criteria of varying difficulties to complete combat challenges.

· Combat comprises a total of 4 waves. Defeat all enemies to beat the challenge. If you fail the challenge, the challenge must be re-attempted from the beginning.

· Test Criteria come in three difficulty levels: 1/2/3. Your Total Test Criteria is the sum of difficulty levels of all selected Test Criteria. As you reach higher Total Test Criteria records, Criteria Sets for different regions will unlock over time.

· Some Test Criteria are [Locked Criteria]. Select the specified [Key Criteria] to unlock them.

· After event launch, new Test Criteria will be added on day 8. However, they cannot be selected if their Criteria Set is still locked.

· A new cycle mission will be added every 3 days during the event. There are 7 cycle missions in total, and all missions will remain available until the event ends.

· During the event, meet specified conditions to obtain the event-exclusive engraved medal.


▼// [Sanctuary Rating] Display System

· Successfully completing a challenge with a Total Test Criteria of at least 1 activates the event-exclusive [Sanctuary Rating], which can be displayed on your Friends screen.

· [Sanctuary Rating] will only be active for the duration of this event.


▼// Important Notes

· All Contract Missions and combat challenges will close when the event ends.

· After the event ends, [Secret Sanctuary] will remain open until 04:00, July 23, 2026 (server time) for you to exchange rewards. Once [Secret Sanctuary] closes, all unused [Vitrified Coins] will be cleared.

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].
